messages:
Maria: opened a PR to add a new nodepool for H100 workloads — mixed reserved + spot. asking for config + secrets wiring check. PR: https://git.reddo/infra/terraform/pull/842 :wave:
Aj: nice. can you paste the tf snippet and the target capacity/reserve counts? also curious about taints/tolerations we should use
Maria: sure — planned topology:
- reserved: 4 x h100 (capacity_reservation)
- spot autoscale: min 0 / max 16, target 8 (mixed instances allowed)
- zones: 3 AZs
- taint: gpu=exclusive:NoSchedule
- priorityClass for latency jobs: high-gpu

TF snippet (simplified):
```hcl
resource "aws_eks_node_group" "h100_mixed" {
  cluster_name = var.cluster
  node_group_name = "h100-mixed-reserve"
  instance_types = ["p4d.24xlarge", "h100.8xlarge"]
  scaling_config { desired_size = 8; min_size = 0; max_size = 16 }
  capacity_type = "SPOT"
  labels = { "accelerator" = "h100" }
  taints = [{ key = "gpu", value = "exclusive", effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" }]
  launch_template { id = aws_launch_template.h100.id }
}
```
Samir: couple notes:
- for reserved nodes use a small separate node group with capacity_type = "ON_DEMAND" + capacity_reservation (provider-specific) — we want predictable latency for priorityClass pods
- use `kube_preemption_policy: Never`? actually prefer `priorityClass` + `podDisruptionBudget` + eviction handler that drains gracefully
- tolerations should be explicit: `key: gpu, operator: Equal, value: exclusive, effect: NoSchedule`

Aj: how are we wiring IAM/instance profile + secret for GPU driver/cuda bundles? any sops/secret-manager changes needed?
Maria: driver daemonset uses an S3 staging bucket for the installer tarball and an IAM role on nodes to read it. For reserved group we attach `arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-reserve-role`. For spot group we attach `gpu-spot-role` with read-only S3 + secretsmanager access. secrets (kms-encrypted) stored in repo `infra/secrets/gpu` (sops).
Leo: make sure node pool tags include `team: inference` and `env: prod` so billing + routing rules pick them up. Also add `k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled=true` tag for spot group

OncallBot: reminder: add taint toleration and a `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120` to critical pods; set up node-terminate-handler to cordon + drain on spot termination (docs: https://docs.reddo/ops/spot-fallback)

Maria: noted. Updated PR with:
- separate tf resource for reserved `aws_eks_node_group.h100_reserved`
- IAM instance profile resources + sops path in variables
- node labels/tags and autoscaler tags
- added deploy hook to run `helm upgrade --install nvidia-drivers` post nodepool create

Samir: also add `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` node affinity to prefer h100 instance types for latency jobs, fallback to p4d if not available

Aj: quick config nit: for spot group set `max_unavailable` to 1 in the DaemonSet rollouts or use `maxUnavailable: 10%` for driver updates

Maria: added `maxUnavailable: 1` and `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 120` to the critical DS. pushed a tfplan screenshot to PR description.

DeployBot: preview env created for pr/842 — cluster: preview-h100-842, kubeconfig: /tmp/kube/pr-842.kubeconfig

Aj: I left a couple of inline comments on the PR about the IAM role policy (narrow down S3 path and SecretsManager ARN). otherwise lgtm from infra side :thumbsup:

Leo: ran `tf plan` locally — looks clean. approving once Aj's IAM policy comments are addressed

Maria: thanks all. I'll address IAM comments and merge tomorrow morning during low traffic window. tagging @oncall for rollout notify

OncallBot: noted — patch rollout scheduled 2023-11-08T07:00:00Z, oncall: Leo

Maria: awesome. thanks :raised_hands:
